text:
maria: Heads-up — a new candidate landed in model-shelf: capella-14b-compact. Can we do a quick prioritization pass for bring-up? Need: perf smoke, quant baseline, and basic evals.

alex: +1. do we have sample traces or a token-latency baseline on p4d? otherwise rough estimate is fine for triage.

maria: I ran a lightweight perf job on a 16k seq with default compilation flags. Rough numbers: 1.8ms/token (batch=1, kv cache cold), 0.9ms/token warm. Model size ~14.3B. P95 tail was ~25ms. Pushed logs here: https://internal.redwood/models/capella-14b-compact/logs

jordan: Nice. Any quality gotchas? instruction-following, safety, hallucination?

maria: Quick evals attached: instructions OK at 92% pass on our instruction-suite, but we saw hallucination on knowledge cutoff questions (hall rate ~18%). Also poor long-context coherence after 8k. Eval link: https://internal.redwood/evals/capella-14b-compact/report

sam: For quantization experiments, recommend trying 4-bit GPTQ and 8-bit LLM.int8. Need to know sensitivity of MLP kernels. I can queue a 4-bit run if we greenlight priority.

liz: Can we check alignment with roadmap? Q2 theme is "latency-first small models" so this might fit if the cost delta is meaningful. What's the expected cost saving vs base 13b?

maria: Estimating ~15% less memory and ~10% lower token cost after compilation kernels. If 4-bit works, could be 30-40% cost savings.

triage-bot: auto-score: compute_alignment=6/10, user_impact=5/10, risk=4/10. aggregated_score=52. Suggested priority: Medium. Reason: decent latency profile, some quality regressions on long context.

alex: Thanks. Proposal: assign owner, run 4-bit GPTQ smoke, and add to next week's bring-up slot. If GPTQ fails or hallucination > 20% we pause. Anyone volunteer to own?

jordan: I can take ownership for the quant smoke + basic evals. Will queue jobs tomorrow and post results here.

maria: Awesome — jord, please fill the onboarding checklist and add the observed numbers: https://internal.redwood/onboard-checklist (fields: perf_baseline, quant_runs, eval_report, rollout_plan). Also drop sample prompts that trigger the hallucination.

jordan: Will do. Quick notes I'll add: `perf_baseline: 1.8ms/token cold, 0.9ms warm`, `quant_plan: 4-bit GPTQ -> 8-bit int8 fallback`, `eval_targets: instruction_suite, long_context_coherence, safety_checks`

sam: If you need a slot, I can reallocate an extra GPU for the GPTQ job next Tue.

maria: Thanks — decision for now: Medium priority, owner=jordan, action items: jordan run GPTQ smoke + post results (due +48h), maria to collate hallucination prompts, sam to reserve GPU if needed. We'll re-evaluate at weekly model-review on Friday. :thumbsup:

alex: Sounds good. :eyes:

triage-bot: created ticket INC-3124 and added label `bringup:medium` and `quant-candidate`.
